notes.title: This update aims to fix the seasonal split.
notes.content: I have (HOPEFULLY) simplified matters for those who wished to play seasons 1 and 2 in continuation. All you need to do if you are someone who owns season 2 is take the Seasontwo.rpa file copy it and then paste it where season one is installed. As far as saves are concerned, most of my saves did work, but some did not. The most consistent save that always works for me, is the save at the end of the season with Alice. There is nothing I can do about breaking saves. Renpy has changed things and my current version of it is different from the games release version. The simplest solution to dealing with save issues is to start a new game and skip past all the seen content. I have also preset the season 2 script to expect a season 3 release. This way we can avoid the same issues on season 3.
